name: NusukChat 2.8.7: Figma round of 19 November, new General Error
source: The DL Advisor's updates to 💬 Chat UI on 18–19 November 2026 (AI Chat Messages now 25 variants; 7 sets, 55 variants, 3 masters). Read variant by variant and measured against the code at the Figma width (552).

added.change: A Nusuk/BG question that stops the flow: type row, the 72 error mark (Alerts/Surface/Error, alert-01 38 in Alerts/Icons/Error), 18 below the message in Body 1 Regular (318 column), one Primary MD CTA. No footer actions.

changed.change: 42 Ink play button (was 30); waveform of 3-wide round bars on Surface/Longing, 8 pitch, played 100% and the rest 30%; no timer (the duration moves into the play button's label).
Content No BG keeps 18 inline padding (a later rule had set it to 0). Hotel and Flights: the question card stays full width and the list sits 12 below it.
the date is Display 1 Regular 32 (was Display 2 Light 28).

Months_Interaction: Ivory pill 52, 18 start / 4 end, month in Headline 2 with a 24 calendar icon, the switch as two 42 white round buttons; weekday labels 48 high in text-subtle; calendar 8 in; month and calendar flush.
the blocks sit flush; the note row is 18 all round, Notes 12 Regular in Alerts/Text/Default with the muslim icon.
the email and Edit sit in the question block, 8 below the title (were in the content, 20 below).
three criteria, as Figma lists them (was five).
12 between the icon row and the text (was 18); title 14 and description 16, 4 apart.
8 between the cards and the field; 12 between IBAN fields.
the 86 scan sits in a 134 photo frame (24 in); copy and hint in a 318 column, 12 apart; the CTA sits below the content like every question.
steps in Body 2 (was Notes 1); the image glows (the image again, 12 in, 18 down, blur 40, 40%); cards 120 high, 12 apart, 12 below the steps.
option cards drop the 1 px line (white with Glass/Full), 66 high.

openDL: 📅 Day Picker is 40×48 in Figma; the DL DayPicker renders 40×40 (Days is 40 shorter than Figma).
Pray Card is 110×90 in Figma; the DL PrayCard renders 113 high (Slots is 23 taller).
_Master Select Card has 12 between the icon row and the text; the DL SelectCard card says 18.
Hotel Offer is 318×515 and Flight Ticket Full 259 high in this file; the chat's HotelCard (316×424) and FlightTicketFull (≈234) still differ (AI9: move to the DL HotelCard and FlightTicket).

native.ios: Voice: Circle 42 Ink + an HStack(spacing: 5) of Capsule(width: 3) bars on surfaceLonging (opacity 0.3 until played). GeneralError: Circle 72 alertsSurfaceError with alert-01 at 38, 18 above a Body 1 Text, then the Primary MD button. Bubble paddings unchanged.
native.android: Voice: Box(42.dp, CircleShape, surface10Ink) + Row(spacedBy(5.dp)) of 3.dp RoundedCornerShape bars. GeneralError: Box(72.dp, CircleShape, alertsSurfaceError) { Icon(38.dp) }, Spacer(18.dp), Text(body1), Button(primary, md).

breaking: Voice no longer renders a timer element (.nkc-timer inside .nkc-voice); read the duration from the play button's aria-label.
PasswordField checks three rules, not five.
